name: Lantern d20
about: Fantasy adventure with a twenty-sided die: six abilities, armour, hit points.

name: Six Sides
about: Roll a handful of six-sided dice and count the fives and sixes. Sixes roll again.

name: Three Hearts
about: For the youngest players: three hearts, one thing you are good at, one die.

name: Hard Knocks
about: Gritty skirmishes: wounds bleed until you staunch them, and a natural 20 rolls on the critical table. Brings scripts.
